title: Robotics: Staubli TX2-90L model, quintic and Cartesian linear profiles, Robot.SetControl and PreStepControl
author: Claude-JG
description: models.py has no Staubli robot, motion.py no quintic polynomial profile and no Cartesian path, and every robot example writes its own PreStepUserFunction for the joint control. Decided: ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L from the joint frames of its URDF (dhMode jointFrames, estimated inertias); ProfilePolynomial5 and ProfileCartesianLinear (the tool on a straight line with the rotation on SO(3), the joint coordinates by the analytic IK at each evaluation); Robot.SetControl(trajectory, compensation) and Robot.PreStepControl(mbs, t) for the kinematic tree; an example of the TX2-90L with joint-space and Cartesian trajectories.
releaseNotes: exudyn.robotics: ManipulatorStaubliTX2_90L (the kinematics of its URDF, estimated inertias) and dhMode 'jointFrames' of LinkDict2Robot; the profiles ProfilePolynomial5 and ProfileCartesianLinear (a straight line of the tool, the joint coordinates by the analytic inverse kinematics at each evaluation); Robot.SetControl(trajectory, compensation) and Robot.PreStepControl(mbs, t) for the joint control of the kinematic tree; the example staubliTX2trajectories.py.
